scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2 MUNDARIJASI (3-bet, PDF 2). Yuqorida to'q sariq 'Contents'. Har unit och pushti yo'lakda. Mashq yo'q.

RO'YXAT:
Unit 1 Subject/Object Personal Pronouns - The Verb "to be" - Have got - Can - Present Simple - Present Continuous ... p. 4
Unit 2 Adverbs of Frequency - Past Simple - Used to - So - Neither/Nor ... p. 10
Unit 3 Adjectives/Order of Adjectives/Comparisons - Expressing Certainty - Will ... p. 14
Unit 4 Adjectives - Adverbs - Past Continuous ... p. 20
Unit 5 Future Simple - Be going to - Present Continuous - Conditionals Type 1 - When/If ... p. 24
Unit 6 Some - Any/Much - Many/A Few - A Little/Phrases of Quantity - Giving Advice - Conditionals Type 0 - Time Words ... p. 30
Unit 7 Present Perfect Simple - Past Simple vs Present Perfect Simple - Present Perfect Continuous ... p. 34
Unit 8 Past Perfect Simple - Past Continuous vs Past Perfect Simple ... p. 40
Unit 9 The Passive - Too - Enough ... p. 44
Unit 10 The Imperative - Reflexive Pronouns - Might/Could - Must/Have to - Can/Be allowed to - Could/Couldn't ... p. 50
Unit 11 Conditionals Type 2 ... p. 54
Unit 12 Describing Location - Relative Pronouns - Relative Adverbs - Some/Any/No ... p. 58
Unit 13 The Infinitive - The -ing form ... p. 62
Unit 14 Reported Speech - Reported Statements - Say/Tell - Reported Questions ... p. 66
Unit 15 Reported Instructions/Commands - Exclamations - Question Tags ... p. 72
Irregular Verbs ... p. 76
Progress Tests ... p. 77

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '3'. Orqa tomondan (4-bet) matn ko'rinib turibdi.

⚠ Titul va mualliflik huquqi betlari (1-2) skanda yo'q - PDF 1 muqova, PDF 2 mundarija (3-bet). Demak PDF N = kitob N+1.
⚠ 15 unit Coursebook'ning 15 uniti bilan BIR XIL raqamlangan - ilovada bir unitga birlashadi.

exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMAR 2 - 15 UNIT + ILOVALAR.

  Har unit Coursebook'ning shu
  raqamli unitidagi grammatikani
  chuqurroq beradi:

  1 (4-bet) Olmoshlar, to be, have
    got, can, Present Simple /
    Continuous
  2 (10) Chastota ravishlari, Past
    Simple, used to, So / Neither
  3 (14) Sifatlar, qiyoslash,
    ishonch, will
  4 (20) Sifat va ravish, Past
    Continuous
  5 (24) Kelajak (will / going to /
    Present Continuous), 1-tur
    shart gap, when / if
  6 (30) some / any / much / many /
    a few / a little, maslahat,
    0-tur shart gap, vaqt so'zlari
  7 (34) Present Perfect Simple /
    Continuous, Past Simple bilan
    farqi
  8 (40) Past Perfect, Past
    Continuous bilan farqi
  9 (44) Majhul nisbat, too /
    enough
  10 (50) Buyruq, o'zlik olmoshlari,
    might / could / must / have to
    / can / be allowed to
  11 (54) 2-tur shart gap
  12 (58) Joylashuv, nisbiy
    olmoshlar (who / which / whose)
    va ravishlar (where / when),
    some / any / no
  13 (62) Infinitiv va -ing shakli
  14 (66) Ko'chirma gap: darak,
    say / tell, savollar
  15 (72) Ko'chirma buyruq, undov
    gaplar, question tags

  ILOVALAR:
  Irregular Verbs (76) - noto'g'ri
    fe'llar jadvali
  Progress Tests (77) - nazorat
    testlari


⚠ TUZILISh:

  Har unit: NAZARIYA (jadval +
  qoida) → MAShQLAR. Ba'zi unitlar
  4 bet, ba'zilari 6 bet.
